why: The pips arm's burst ring stops inheriting the pip's animation delay (issue #230). `animation-delay` is not an inherited property, so when the HUD re-attaches a running cue with a negative delay on the pip, the pip resumes mid-swell while its ::after ring starts its burst over -- the two halves of one cue out of step after any rebuild. Pinned in the stylesheet test because jsdom does not run pseudo-element animations.
killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) passes the resumed delay to the pip's burst ring, which does not inherit it by default
